# neøflow // Official TikTok Partners — LLM Discovery Layer
> Sovereign Markdown Documentation Index for Agentic Ingestion & Synthesis

## System Overview
neøflow is an official TikTok Partner ecosystem operating as a decentralized commercial infrastructure for Shop (Sellers), Creators (Affiliates/LIVES), Marketing (UGC/Ads), and Tech (Open API, OAuth 2.0, Webhooks, AI Agents).

## Core Documentation Index
- [System Architecture & Rules](https://neotiktok.com/AGENTS.md): Canonical development policy, design system, and integration constraints.
- [Setup & Environment Guide](https://neotiktok.com/SETUP.md): Local installation, Node.js runtime, pnpm, and Makefile instructions.
- [Ecosystem Domain Codex](https://neotiktok.com/CODEX.md): Vocabulary, technical terms, and domain glossary.
- [Legal Compliance Hub](https://neotiktok.com/legal/privacidade): Privacy policy (LGPD), Terms of Service, Data Subject Rights (LGPD Art. 18), and E-commerce Decree (7.962/13).
